nodes.description: Private owner address stored in Ownable, controls privileged functions such as mint.
Mapping of account balances in the ERC20 token; mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Nested mapping of owner to spender allowances; read by transferFrom and written by _approve.
Total token supply; increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Token name set to Bigmac.finance in the ERC20 constructor.
Token symbol set to BIG in the ERC20 constructor.
Token decimals, initialized to 18 and changeable via _setupDecimals.
External/public mint(address _to, uint256 _amount) guarded by onlyOwner that creates new BIG tokens.
Internal ERC20 _mint(address account, uint256 amount) that increases supply and recipient balance.
Internal ERC20 _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) moving balances after the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
Public ERC20 transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) that moves tokens from _msgSender().
Public ERC20 transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) that moves tokens using the allowance mechanism.
Public ERC20 approve(address spender, uint256 amount) that sets an allowance for msg.sender.
Internal ERC20 _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) that writes the allowances mapping.
Ownable renounceOwnership() that sets _owner to address(0) under onlyOwner.
Ownable transferOwnership(address newOwner) that reassigns _owner under onlyOwner.
Context helper returning msg.sender, used for authentication and caller-based accounting.
Virtual ERC20 hook invoked before minting, burning and transferring; overridable in derived contracts.
Public view returning the current _owner address.
Public ERC20 increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) using SafeMath.add on allowances.
Public ERC20 decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) using SafeMath.sub on allowances.
Internal ERC20 _burn(address account, uint256 amount) decreasing balance and total supply.
msg.sender, attacker-controllable caller identity used for ownership checks and token accounting.
Token creation operation: privileged increase of _totalSupply and recipient balance in _mint.
Balance mutation operation: subtraction and addition on the _balances mapping inside _transfer.
Privileged ownership state write on _owner performed by renounceOwnership and transferOwnership.
Address parameter _to of BigmacToken.mint receiving the minted tokens.
Unsigned integer parameter _amount of BigmacToken.mint specifying mint quantity.
Address parameter account of _mint that receives newly created tokens.
Unsigned integer parameter amount of _mint specifying the amount created.
Address parameter sender of _transfer whose balance is debited.
Address parameter recipient of _transfer whose balance is credited.
Unsigned integer parameter amount of _transfer moved between accounts.
Address parameter recipient of the public transfer function.
Unsigned integer parameter amount of the public transfer function.
Address parameter sender of transferFrom whose allowance is consumed.
Address parameter recipient of transferFrom receiving the tokens.
Unsigned integer parameter amount of transferFrom checked against the allowance.
Address parameter spender granted an allowance in approve.
Unsigned integer parameter amount of allowance set in approve.
Address parameter newOwner that becomes the new _owner in transferOwnership.
Local variable msgSender in the Ownable constructor holding _msgSender().

edges.reason: Parameter _to of mint flows into the token creation call.
Parameter _amount of mint flows into the token creation call.
mint invokes the internal _mint routine.
account parameter determines which balance _mint credits.
amount parameter determines how much supply _mint creates.
_mint executes the privileged token creation operation.
Total supply is increased arithmetically on every mint operation.
Recipient balance is increased through SafeMath.add inside _mint.
_mint invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before the supply bookkeeping is final, allowing derived-contract reentrancy.
_transfer calls the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook, an external callback point before balances are settled.
_transfer performs the balance subtraction/addition arithmetic of the token movement.
The balance mutation operation writes the _balances state mapping.
sender parameter directs which balance is debited in _transfer.
recipient parameter directs which balance is credited in _transfer.
amount parameter controls the size of the balance movement in _transfer.
recipient parameter of the public transfer flows into the internal transfer.
amount parameter of the public transfer flows into the internal transfer.
Public transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
_msgSender supplies the sender of the public transfer.
sender parameter of transferFrom is used both for the transfer and the allowance deduction.
recipient parameter of transferFrom receives the tokens.
amount parameter of transferFrom bounds how much allowance is consumed.
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the allowance through _approve.
The _allowances mapping is read to validate the spender allowance in transferFrom.
_msgSender identifies the spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom.
spender parameter of approve becomes the allowance beneficiary.
amount parameter of approve becomes the new allowance value.
Public approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
_approve writes the _allowances state mapping.
_msgSender is the owner of the allowance set by approve.
increaseAllowance funnels the new allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance funnels the reduced allowance through _approve.
_burn subtracts from the holder balance through SafeMath.sub.
_burn reduces the total supply arithmetically.
newOwner parameter is written into the owner state by transferOwnership.
transferOwnership performs the privileged ownership state write guarded by onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership performs the privileged ownership state write guarded by onlyOwner.
msg.sender is compared against _owner by the onlyOwner modifier protecting mint.
msg.sender must equal _owner for renounceOwnership to proceed.
msg.sender must equal _owner for transferOwnership to proceed.
renounceOwnership authenticates through the _msgSender helper.
transferOwnership authenticates through the _msgSender helper.
_msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
The Ownable constructor stores _msgSender() in the local msgSender variable.
owner() reads the _owner state variable.
The onlyOwner check on mint compares the stored _owner against the caller.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is an argument of mint and has no independent semantic role outside that function.
_amount is an argument of mint and is fully consumed by its token creation call.
account only parameterizes the internal _mint balance credit.
amount only parameterizes the supply and balance increase in _mint.
sender is a positional argument of _transfer with no standalone meaning.
recipient is a positional argument of _transfer with no standalone meaning.
amount is a positional argument that only drives the _transfer arithmetic.
recipient of the public transfer is forwarded directly to _transfer.
amount of the public transfer is forwarded directly to _transfer.
sender only parameterizes the transferFrom delegation and allowance lookup.
recipient only parameterizes the transferFrom delegation.
amount only parameterizes the transferFrom allowance deduction.
spender is an argument of approve forwarded to _approve.
amount is an argument of approve forwarded to _approve.
newOwner is the sole argument of transferOwnership and is stored into _owner.
msgSender is a temporary local caches the result of _msgSender() in the Ownable constructor.
